policy: Check the hive temperament before lifting the honey frames. The honey is spun in the extractor at the processing shed. The extracted honey is jarred into retail jars. Order replacement queens in March.

tools.name: check_hive_temperament
tools.description: Observes the hive entrance and returns an agitation score for the colony without opening the hive.

tools.name: lift_honey_frames
tools.description: Removes the honey frames from the super and stacks them on the carrier for transport.

tools.name: spin_extractor
tools.description: Loads frames into the centrifugal extractor and spins the honey out into the settling tank.

tools.name: jar_honey
tools.description: Fills retail jars from the settling tank and applies the batch labels.

tools.name: order_queens
tools.description: Places a replacement queen order with the breeder and records the expected delivery week.

tools.name: read_stock_levels
tools.description: Returns current counts of jars, frames and spare supers in the storage shed.

policy: Weigh each linen batch at intake. Load the washer only after the batch is weighed. Start the dryer cycle only after the washer is loaded. Invoice the hotel clients weekly.

tools.name: weigh_batch
tools.description: Places the linen batch on the platform scale and records the weight on the intake ticket.

tools.name: load_washer
tools.description: Loads a weighed batch into the tunnel washer and selects the programme.

tools.name: start_dryer
tools.description: Starts the tumble dryer cycle for a washed batch and sets the drying time.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Emails the weekly service invoice to a hotel client with the batch totals.

policy: A colour proof approval is required before binding the catalogues. The covers are laminated in the morning batch. Catalogues are boxed for delivery on Fridays.

tools.name: check_proof_approval
tools.description: Looks up the colour proof record for a print job and returns whether the client has approved it.

tools.name: bind_catalogues
tools.description: Binds the printed signatures into finished catalogues on the binding line.

tools.name: laminate_covers
tools.description: Feeds cover sheets through the laminator and stacks the finished covers.

tools.name: box_catalogues
tools.description: Packs finished catalogues into delivery boxes and prints the shipping labels.

policy: A colour proof approval is required before laminating the covers. The catalogues are bound on the saddle stitcher. Catalogues are boxed for delivery on Fridays.

tools.name: check_proof_approval
tools.description: Looks up the colour proof record for a print job and returns whether the client has approved it.

tools.name: bind_catalogues
tools.description: Binds the printed signatures into finished catalogues on the binding line.

tools.name: laminate_covers
tools.description: Feeds cover sheets through the laminator and stacks the finished covers.

tools.name: box_catalogues
tools.description: Packs finished catalogues into delivery boxes and prints the shipping labels.

policy: Scan the borrower card before issuing the reserved titles. Notify hold pickup patrons by SMS in the afternoon. The route van is fuelled at the depot every morning.

tools.name: scan_borrower_card
tools.description: Reads the borrower card barcode and returns the membership status and any fines.

tools.name: issue_titles
tools.description: Checks reserved titles out to a borrower and updates the loan records.

tools.name: send_pickup_sms
tools.description: Sends an SMS notification to patrons whose held titles are ready for pickup.

tools.name: fuel_van
tools.description: Refuels the route van at the depot pump and logs the odometer reading.

policy: Resurface the ice before opening the rink to skaters. Measure the ice thickness before flooding the rink for the night. The skate rental counter opens at ten.

tools.name: resurface_ice
tools.description: Drives the resurfacer over the rink ice to renew the skating surface.

tools.name: open_rink
tools.description: Opens the rink gates to public skating and starts the session clock.

tools.name: measure_ice
tools.description: Bores a measurement hole and returns the ice thickness in millimetres.

tools.name: flood_rink
tools.description: Floods the rink surface with the water hose to build a fresh ice layer overnight.

tools.name: open_counter
tools.description: Opens the skate rental counter and unlocks the rental till.

policy: An inspected blade guard is required before ripping oak beams. The planing bench is cleaned at shift end. Beam ends are squared on the chop saw.

tools.name: inspect_blade_guard
tools.description: Checks the saw blade guard for cracks and secure fixings and returns a pass or fail per guard.

tools.name: rip_timber
tools.description: Rips timber stock into beams on the band saw and stacks the output.

tools.name: clean_bench
tools.description: Clears shavings from the planing bench and sweeps the surrounding floor.

tools.name: square_ends
tools.description: Squares the beam ends on the chop saw and marks the finished lengths.

policy: An inspected blade guard is required before squaring beam ends. Oak beams are ripped on the band saw. The planing bench is cleaned at shift end.

tools.name: inspect_blade_guard
tools.description: Checks the saw blade guard for cracks and secure fixings and returns a pass or fail per guard.

tools.name: rip_timber
tools.description: Rips timber stock into beams on the band saw and stacks the output.

tools.name: clean_bench
tools.description: Clears shavings from the planing bench and sweeps the surrounding floor.

tools.name: square_ends
tools.description: Squares the beam ends on the chop saw and marks the finished lengths.

policy: Before flying the falcons in the display, weigh each bird on the arena scale. The jesses are inspected in the equipment room on Mondays. Feed the birds from the glove in the evening.

tools.name: weigh_falcon
tools.description: Places a falcon on the arena scale and records its weight on the daily chart.

tools.name: log_display_flight
tools.description: Registers a display flight for a falcon in the flying register and marks the bird as flown.

tools.name: inspect_jesses
tools.description: Examines the leather jesses and anklets for wear and returns a condition report.

tools.name: log_feeding
tools.description: Records an evening feeding from the glove in the feeding register.

policy: Before feeding the birds from the glove, weigh each bird on the arena scale. The falcons are flown in the afternoon display. The jesses are inspected in the equipment room on Mondays.

tools.name: weigh_falcon
tools.description: Places a falcon on the arena scale and records its weight on the daily chart.

tools.name: log_display_flight
tools.description: Registers a display flight for a falcon in the flying register and marks the bird as flown.

tools.name: inspect_jesses
tools.description: Examines the leather jesses and anklets for wear and returns a condition report.

tools.name: log_feeding
tools.description: Records an evening feeding from the glove in the feeding register.

policy: A valid access badge and a completed safety induction are both required before racking any server. Rack temperature alarms are acknowledged on the console.

tools.name: check_badge
tools.description: Reads the badge reader entry for a technician and returns whether the badge is currently valid.

tools.name: check_induction
tools.description: Looks up the training register and returns whether a technician has completed the data hall safety induction.

tools.name: rack_server
tools.description: Mounts a server into a rack, connects the power and network cables, and registers the unit.

tools.name: acknowledge_alarm
tools.description: Acknowledges a rack temperature alarm on the operations console and adds a handling note.

policy: Calibrate the radiosonde against the reference chamber each Monday. Log the surface wind reading at the morning stand-up. The hydrogen cylinders are stored in the outer shed. Launch the balloon at dawn.

tools.name: calibrate_radiosonde
tools.description: Runs a calibration cycle of the radiosonde against the reference chamber and stores the offsets.

tools.name: log_wind_reading
tools.description: Writes the current surface wind reading into the station weather log.

tools.name: read_cylinder_store
tools.description: Returns the count and pressure class of hydrogen cylinders currently in the store.

tools.name: launch_balloon
tools.description: Releases the weather balloon with the radiosonde and starts the ascent tracking record.

policy: Points grinding on the coastal line requires a lockout confirmation. The grinder may be coupled to the railhead only after the signalman posts the confirmation on the board. Track circuits are polled from the panel every hour.

tools.name: check_lockout_confirmation
tools.description: Queries the signal box system for the lockout confirmation state of a track section.

tools.name: couple_grinder
tools.description: Couples the rail grinder to the railhead and arms the grinding programme.

tools.name: poll_track_circuits
tools.description: Polls the track circuit states from the signal panel and returns occupied or clear per section.

policy: Check the gas bottle seals before firing the griddle. The fridge temperature is logged at each stop. Restock the napkin dispensers from the depot cage. Fry the batter in the morning batch.

tools.name: check_gas_seal
tools.description: Tests each gas bottle connection with leak spray and returns a tight or leaking result per bottle.

tools.name: ignite_griddle
tools.description: Ignites the griddle burners and sets the cooking temperature.

tools.name: log_fridge_temp
tools.description: Records the fridge temperature reading in the food safety log.

tools.name: restock_dispensers
tools.description: Refills the napkin dispensers from depot cage stock.

tools.name: fry_batter
tools.description: Fries the churro batter batch in the fryer and drains the finished pieces.

policy: The substrate is pasteurised in the steam vessel. Humidity readings are noted on the clipboard twice a day. The oyster mushroom strain fruits within three weeks. Harvest the flushes only after the spore print test comes back clean.

tools.name: pasteurise_substrate
tools.description: Loads the substrate into the steam vessel and runs the pasteurisation cycle.

tools.name: log_humidity
tools.description: Writes a humidity reading onto the growing room clipboard.

tools.name: run_spore_print_test
tools.description: Takes a spore print from a fruiting sample and returns a clean or contaminated result.

tools.name: harvest_flushes
tools.description: Cuts the mature mushroom flushes with a blade and packs them for dispatch.

policy: Verify the serial numbers against the police register before accepting any electronic pledge. The display cabinet is polished each morning. Loans are issued against gold after the melt test. The till is counted at closing.

tools.name: verify_serials
tools.description: Checks an item's serial number against the police stolen goods register and returns a hit or clear.

tools.name: accept_pledge
tools.description: Books an electronic item into pawn stock and prints the pledge ticket.

tools.name: polish_cabinet
tools.description: Polishes the display cabinet glass and rearranges the stock trays.

tools.name: run_melt_test
tools.description: Tests a gold item on the touchstone and returns the karat estimate.

tools.name: issue_loan
tools.description: Issues a cash loan against a gold item and records the redemption terms.

tools.name: count_till
tools.description: Counts the till cash at closing and reconciles it against the day's tickets.

policy: A signed consent form is required before ink is applied to a client. Needles are sterilised in the autoclave at session start. Pigment stock is ordered on Mondays.

tools.name: check_consent_form
tools.description: Looks up the client record and returns whether a signed consent form is on file.

tools.name: apply_ink
tools.description: Applies ink to a client's skin with the tattoo machine and records the session.

tools.name: sterilise_needles
tools.description: Loads the needles into the autoclave and runs the sterilisation cycle.

tools.name: order_pigment
tools.description: Places a pigment stock order with the supplier and records the delivery date.

policy: A signed consent form is required before needles are sterilised in the autoclave. Ink is applied to a client at session start. Pigment stock is ordered on Mondays.

tools.name: check_consent_form
tools.description: Looks up the client record and returns whether a signed consent form is on file.

tools.name: apply_ink
tools.description: Applies ink to a client's skin with the tattoo machine and records the session.

tools.name: sterilise_needles
tools.description: Loads the needles into the autoclave and runs the sterilisation cycle.

tools.name: order_pigment
tools.description: Places a pigment stock order with the supplier and records the delivery date.

policy: Blasting on the north face may proceed only after the vibration permit is countersigned. Trucks are loaded at the face all shift. The scale house weighs trucks at the gate.

tools.name: check_permit_signature
tools.description: Reads the permit folder and returns whether the vibration permit carries the required countersignature.

tools.name: blast_face
tools.description: Fires the planned blast on a quarry face and logs the shot details.

tools.name: load_trucks
tools.description: Loads blasted rock into haul trucks at the face with the excavator.

tools.name: weigh_trucks
tools.description: Weighs a truck on the scale house bridge and returns the net weight.

policy: Truck loading at the face may proceed only after the vibration permit is countersigned. Blasting on the north face is planned for the afternoon shift. The scale house weighs trucks at the gate.

tools.name: check_permit_signature
tools.description: Reads the permit folder and returns whether the vibration permit carries the required countersignature.

tools.name: blast_face
tools.description: Fires the planned blast on a quarry face and logs the shot details.

tools.name: load_trucks
tools.description: Loads blasted rock into haul trucks at the face with the excavator.

tools.name: weigh_trucks
tools.description: Weighs a truck on the scale house bridge and returns the net weight.

policy: Mirror cooldown must precede opening the dome shutters. The dew heater is switched on at sunset. Visitor logs are kept at the gatehouse.

tools.name: check_mirror_temperature
tools.description: Reads the primary mirror temperature sensors and returns whether the mirror has reached ambient temperature.

tools.name: open_shutters
tools.description: Opens the dome shutters and registers the start of the observing session.

tools.name: switch_dew_heater
tools.description: Switches the mirror dew heater on or off and records the change.

tools.name: read_visitor_log
tools.description: Returns the entries currently in the gatehouse visitor log.

policy: Mirror cooldown must precede switching on the dew heater. The dome shutters are opened at dusk. Visitor logs are kept at the gatehouse.

tools.name: check_mirror_temperature
tools.description: Reads the primary mirror temperature sensors and returns whether the mirror has reached ambient temperature.

tools.name: open_shutters
tools.description: Opens the dome shutters and registers the start of the observing session.

tools.name: switch_dew_heater
tools.description: Switches the mirror dew heater on or off and records the change.

tools.name: read_visitor_log
tools.description: Returns the entries currently in the gatehouse visitor log.

policy: Sedating a feline patient requires either a same-day weight on the lobby scale or a verified dose chart from the technician. Kennel runs are disinfected after each patient. Invoice the owners at discharge.

tools.name: weigh_feline
tools.description: Places a cat on the lobby scale and returns the same-day weight in kilograms.

tools.name: check_dose_chart
tools.description: Looks up the feline dose chart and returns whether the technician has verified it for the current drug batch.

tools.name: sedate_feline
tools.description: Administers the sedative dose to a feline patient and records vitals during induction.

tools.name: disinfect_run
tools.description: Disinfects a kennel run between patients and marks it ready in the boarding board.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Emails the treatment invoice to the owner at discharge.

policy: Threading the projector may begin only after the film reel is inspected. Start the projection test only after threading is finished. Dim the house lights from the console.

tools.name: inspect_reel
tools.description: Examines a film reel for splices and damage and returns a condition report.

tools.name: thread_projector
tools.description: Threads the film reel through the projector gate and marks the reel as loaded.

tools.name: run_test_projection
tools.description: Runs the projection test loop and records the focus and sound levels.

tools.name: dim_lights
tools.description: Dims the house lights from the console to the show preset.

policy: The cement silo level is checked and the mixer drums are greased in the morning routine. Batch tickets are printed for each truck at the gate.

tools.name: check_silo_level
tools.description: Reads the cement silo level sensors and returns the remaining tonnes per silo.

tools.name: grease_drums
tools.description: Greases the mixer drum bearings and logs the service in the plant book.

tools.name: print_batch_ticket
tools.description: Prints the batch ticket for a truck at the gate with the mix design and load weight.

policy: Spraying may proceed over vineyards unless the wind speed exceeds three metres per second. Record the wind speed at the boom throughout the job. The sprayer tank is rinsed at the depot.

tools.name: check_wind_speed
tools.description: Reads the anemometer at the boom and returns the current wind speed in metres per second.

tools.name: spray_vineyard
tools.description: Sprays the pesticide mix over the vineyard rows and logs the treated area.

tools.name: log_wind_reading
tools.description: Writes a wind speed reading from the boom into the spray job record.

tools.name: rinse_tank
tools.description: Rinses the sprayer tank at the depot and disposes of the rinse water.

policy: Lift the containers even if the load cell reading drifts by two percent. Inspect the spreader latches before each lift. The hatch covers are stowed on the quay.

tools.name: read_load_cell
tools.description: Reads the crane load cell and returns the current drift percentage against the calibrated zero.

tools.name: lift_container
tools.description: Hoists a container from the quay onto the vessel and logs the move.

tools.name: inspect_latches
tools.description: Checks the spreader latches engage correctly and returns a per-latch result.

tools.name: read_hatch_register
tools.description: Returns the current stowage positions of hatch covers from the quay register.

policy: Inspect the arrow nocks before stringing the rental bows. The target mats are carried out at opening. Log the attendance sheet at the front desk.

tools.name: archive_inspection_records
tools.description: Checks each arrow nock for cracks and loose fletching and returns a pass or fail per arrow.

tools.name: validate_range_safety
tools.description: Strings a rental bow, fits the string and marks the bow as issued in the rental register.

tools.name: calibrate_target_system
tools.description: Carries the target mats from the store to the firing line and positions them.

tools.name: process_payment_batch
tools.description: Writes the daily attendance entries from the front desk sheet into the range register.

policy: Check the outrigger pads before deploying the mobile crane. The hook block is greased weekly. Dispatch the crane truck after the route survey is filed.

tools.name: schedule_maintenance_visit
tools.description: Verifies each outrigger pad sits on firm level ground and is undamaged; returns a per-pad safety result.

tools.name: update_billing_ledger
tools.description: Raises the mobile crane on its outriggers, secures it and marks the unit as deployed in the yard system.

tools.name: validate_load_cell
tools.description: Packs the hook block bearings with grease and logs the service in the maintenance book.

tools.name: audit_insurance_docs
tools.description: Files the route survey with bridge clearances and cable heights along the planned route.

tools.name: dispatch_truck
tools.description: Dispatches the crane truck on a surveyed route and records the departure time.

policy: Condition the roses in the cold room before arranging any bouquet. Wire the orchid stems after the morning delivery is booked in. The till float is counted at opening. Phone the wedding client on Thursday.

tools.name: condition_roses
tools.description: Conditions rose batches in the cold room: trims stems, hydrates and rests them.

tools.name: arrange_bouquet
tools.description: Arranges conditioned stems into a bouquet and prints the order label.

tools.name: wire_stems
tools.description: Wires orchid stems for corsages and records the wired batch.

tools.name: book_in_delivery
tools.description: Books the morning flower delivery into the goods register with the supplier manifest.

tools.name: count_float
tools.description: Counts the till float at opening and records the starting cash.

tools.name: call_client
tools.description: Phones the wedding client to confirm the order details and logs the call.
